# Papa Kojo Mensah

> Papa Kojo Mensah designs products and directs AI to build them. He calls this being a "design conductor": he decides what to make and how it should feel, AI writes most of the code, and he reviews and tests the result. He made RouteLab, StigmaClear, the OffScript website and English Chat Finder. He is from Kumasi, Ghana, and has worked in customer service at Absa Bank Ghana, in record review through Springboard, and as an independent graphic designer.

## Canonical profile

- [Portfolio](https://pkm.hayalows.com/): Selected work, side experiments, experience, tools, education, a listening panel and contact details.
- [One-page CV](https://pkm.hayalows.com/resume/): Printable curriculum vitae, also downloadable as a PDF from the page.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/papakojomensah): Public professional profile.

## Case studies

- [RouteLab](https://pkm.hayalows.com/work/routelab/): A map that remembers where you go. Route planning, trip recording and a history of movement, with GPS points checked before they count. Live at https://maps.hayalows.com/.
- [StigmaClear](https://pkm.hayalows.com/work/stigmaclear/): A Ghana-first mental-health anti-stigma movement founded by Papa Kojo Mensah, with simple tools and kind letters. Live at https://stigmaclear.com/.
- [OffScript](https://pkm.hayalows.com/work/offscript/): The home of OffScript events in Ghana, starting with Pitch Night. Live at https://offscriptgh.com/.
- [English Chat Finder](https://pkm.hayalows.com/work/english-chat-finder/): Helps BYU-Pathway students find open English Chat sessions in one search. An independent helper, not an official BYU-Pathway tool. Live at https://englishchatsession.vercel.app/.
- [Design Lab](https://ui.hayalows.com/): A library of original React interface components with live previews and copyable code.

## Side experiments

- [Liberation Road in 3D](https://pkm.hayalows.com/accra3d/): An explorable three.js scene from Jubilee House to the Accra Ghana Temple.
- [Drive Studio](https://pkm.hayalows.com/l200/): Inspect and drive two vehicles in 3D.
- [Portfolio Field Notes](https://pkm.hayalows.com/portfolio-field-notes/): Notes from studying 150 designer portfolios.
- [PKM Playground](https://pkm.hayalows.com/playground/): A small illustrated room with a puzzle and a postcard. Puzzle sessions are examples, not bookable events.

## Current positioning

- Role: product designer who directs AI coding agents ("design conductor").
- Looking for: product design and UX roles or internships; also customer service and hospitality roles.
- Past experience: customer service and sales support at Absa Bank Ghana (Nov 2024 to Oct 2025); data entry and record review at Springboard (from April 2026); Iconka Designs, independent graphic design (since 2022).
- Education: BSc Actuarial Science, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, 2024. Hospitality and Tourism Management Certificate, Ensign College through BYU-Pathway, 2026. Social Media Marketing Certificate in progress.

## WebMCP browser tools

- `get_papa_kojo_profile` returns public identity, positioning, location, availability and canonical profile links.
- `get_papa_kojo_skills` returns published capability groups.
- `get_papa_kojo_experience` returns published work history.
- `get_papa_kojo_education` returns published education and training.
- `get_papa_kojo_projects` returns five published projects with canonical live links.
- `prepare_papa_kojo_email` prepares a reversible email draft link but never sends a message or books time.
- Stable result contracts: https://pkm.hayalows.com/webmcp/results.schema.json
